messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] alert=inference.success_ratio tenant=cobalt-prod env=prod severity=PAGER current=87% expected>=99% — paging on-call

incident-bot: link=https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/2035014820 details=spike in 5xx ratio for tenant cobalt-prod

tess (oncall): I'm looking. 5xxs on /v1/generate, rolling window shows spike starting ~14:02 UTC. paging matt and prod-eng.

matt (sre): pulling logs now. getting a lot of backend 502s from model-proxy-3 in us-west-2; connection resets to model host.

jamie (prod-eng): no deploys in the last hour from prod-eng. canary looks fine for other tenants. this is tenant-specific.

olivia (cs): Cobalt support confirmed they're seeing errors in their staging key too. they're worried about SLA alarms. pinged their on-call to confirm user impact.

samir (metrics): query I'm using for the ratio for the ticket (so we can reuse):
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{tenant="cobalt-prod",job="inference",status=~"5.."}[1m]))
/
sum(rate(http_requests_total{tenant="cobalt-prod",job="inference"}[1m]))
```
current 5xx ratio ~12% over 3m, baseline ~0.2%.

tess (oncall): ok. temporary mitigation path: 1) silence PAGER for this rule for cobalt-prod (so we don't page repeatedly) 2) add a high-frequency alert for >10% over 1m as non-pager to catch regressions 3) create dashboard panel to track per-node 502s and proxy connection errors.

matt (sre): +1. I'll add a silence window for the pager for 30m (we'll still log). Also checking model-proxy logs for tls handshake failures and ephemeral network errors.

jamie (prod-eng): idea — route cobalt-prod to model-variant-b fallback (lower mem) while we triage if this is model-host flapping. can we do a soft-fallback?

matt (sre): We can toggle routing at the routing layer, but that affects latency. prefer to fix proxy unless Cobalt prefers quick fallback.

olivia (cs): Cobalt wants minimal customer impact, they'd accept a fallback if it stops errors. they asked for ETA ~30 min.

deploy-bot: deploy noticed: model-host-autoscaler scaled model-host-3 down at 13:58 UTC then scale-up at 14:05 UTC (autoscaler events).

samir (metrics): that autoscaler churn correlates with the timing. autoscaler may have killed active connections causing spikes in 502. We should make the check more resilient to autoscaler-caused transient spikes.

tess (oncall): Agreed. For immediate tuning: change the alert rule for cobalt-prod from "5xx_ratio > 5% for 5m (pager)" to two parts: - pager if 5xx_ratio > 10% for 3m - non-pager noise alert if 5xx_ratio > 6% for 1m. Also add a suppression filter for autoscaler-event tags. I'll open the PR and apply an emergency rule change with a shortlived annotation.

jamie (prod-eng): I'll add a quick routing override to send cobalt-prod to model-variant-b. canary it for 5m and revert if no improvement.

matt (sre): creating silence now and adding a ticket: INCIDENT-2035014820 - cobalt-prod 5xx spike. Adding owner: matt, assignees: jamie, samir.

(5 minutes later)

jamie (prod-eng): routed cobalt-prod -> model-variant-b, monitoring. 5xx ratio dropped to ~1.4% within two minutes. latency +30ms on average.

olivia (cs): Cobalt confirmed errors subsided. thanks. They're okay with fallback while you patch.

matt (sre): removing silence; switching pager back on for the adjusted thresholds. I'll push the emergency alert rule change now. PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/pulls/432 — change rules and add comment about autoscaler churn.

samir (metrics): proposing longer-term: 1) change success_ratio alert semantics to ignore spikes tied to autoscaler event tag (we emit `scale_event=true`) 2) add a per-tenant rolling median filter so single-node churn doesn't page the whole tenant 3) add a dashboard panel with per-node connection resets and autoscaler events overlay.

tess (oncall): action items: - jamie to revert routing after prod-eng fixes or leave fallback if Cobalt requests (owner: jamie) - jamie/samir to post follow-up PR for alert rule changes (owner: samir) - matt to write post-incident note and update runbook with autoscaler guidance (owner: matt) - olivia to send Cobalt a summary (owner: olivia).

jamie (prod-eng): filing ENG ticket ENG-1128 to add graceful drain delay for model-host scale-in (set to 45s) and to add connection-drain logic. attaching logs.

matt (sre): postmortem label + follow-up scheduled. I'll close this pager once PR merged and Cobalt confirms.

(40 minutes later)

olivia (cs): Cobalt confirmed restore and happy with fallback. asked for a change window to be notified before future model-host scaling.

tess (oncall): closing pager. marking as handoff to SRE/Prod-Eng for post-incident tuning.

incident-bot: Incident 2035014820 status=RESOLVED duration=00:47:40 severity=SERVICE_IMPACT notes="temporary routing fallback + alert threshold tuning"

matt (sre): I'll add the change to the alert rule repo and link the dashboard in the runbook. PR merged: https://git.redwood/alerts/pulls/432 (merged). Follow-ups tracked in ENG-1128 and OPS-445.

samir (metrics): added non-pager noise alert and the per-node panel to the inference dashboard.

jamie (prod-eng): left fallback in place until the graceful-drain change is deployed; will revert with a revert comment.

olivia (cs): sending customer note now.

tess (oncall): thanks team. tagging for retro and kcs updates. :handshake:
